```{julia}
ENV["GKSwstype"] = "100"

using DrWatson
@quickactivate "project"

using DataFrames
using Plots
using CSV
using Statistics

include(
    srcdir("sir_model.jl")
)
```

## Матрица миграции

```{julia}
function create_migration_matrix(
    C,
    intensity
)

    M =
        fill(
            intensity / (C - 1),
            C,
            C
        )

    for i in 1:C
        M[i, i] =
            1 - intensity
    end

    return M
end
```

## Один эксперимент

```{julia}
function measure_peak(
    intensity,
    seed
)

    initial_total = 3000

    model =
        initialize_sir(
            Ns=[1000, 1000, 1000],
            β_und=[0.5, 0.5, 0.5],
            β_det=[0.05, 0.05, 0.05],
            infection_period=14,
            detection_time=7,
            death_rate=0.02,
            reinfection_probability=0.1,
            Is=[1, 0, 0],
            seed=seed,
            migration_rates=
                create_migration_matrix(
                    3,
                    intensity
                )
        )

    peak_value = 0.0
    peak_day = 0

    for day in 1:150

        sir_manual_step!(
            model
        )

        fraction =
            infected_count(model) /
            initial_total

        if fraction > peak_value

            peak_value =
                fraction

            peak_day =
                day
        end
    end

    return (
        peak_time=peak_day,
        peak_value=peak_value
    )
end
```

## Сканирование интенсивности миграции

```{julia}
intensities =
    0.0:0.1:0.5

seeds =
    [42, 43, 44]

results =
    NamedTuple[]

println(
    "Исследование миграции..."
)

for intensity in intensities

    for seed in seeds

        result =
            measure_peak(
                intensity,
                seed
            )

        push!(
            results,
            (
                migration_intensity=intensity,
                seed=seed,
                peak_time=result.peak_time,
                peak_value=result.peak_value
            )
        )

        println(
            "migration = ",
            intensity,
            ", seed = ",
            seed,
            " — готово"
        )
    end
end

df =
    DataFrame(
        results
    )

CSV.write(
    datadir(
        "migration_scan_all.csv"
    ),
    df
)

grouped =
    combine(
        groupby(
            df,
            :migration_intensity
        ),

        :peak_time =>
            mean =>
            :mean_peak_time,

        :peak_value =>
            mean =>
            :mean_peak_value
    )

sort!(
    grouped,
    :migration_intensity
)
```

## Ищем минимальное время до пика

```{julia}
best_index =
    argmin(
        grouped.mean_peak_time
    )

println(
    "\nМинимальное среднее время до пика: ",
    round(
        grouped.mean_peak_time[
            best_index
        ],
        digits=2
    ),
    " дней"
)

println(
    "Интенсивность миграции: ",
    grouped.migration_intensity[
        best_index
    ]
)
```

## Графики

```{julia}
p1 =
    plot(
        grouped.migration_intensity,
        grouped.mean_peak_time;
        marker=:circle,
        xlabel="Интенсивность миграции",
        ylabel="Дни",
        label="Время до пика",
        linewidth=2
    )

p2 =
    plot(
        grouped.migration_intensity,
        grouped.mean_peak_value .* 3000;
        marker=:square,
        xlabel="Интенсивность миграции",
        ylabel="Инфицированные",
        label="Численность в пике",
        linewidth=2
    )

p =
    plot(
        p1,
        p2;
        layout=(2, 1),
        size=(800, 700)
    )

savefig(
    p,
    plotsdir(
        "migration_effect.png"
    )
)

println("\nСохранено:")
println("data/migration_scan_all.csv")
println("plots/migration_effect.png")
```

## Вывод

Эксперимент сравнивает момент и масштаб
эпидемического пика при разной мобильности.
